This '''Stormtrooper Commander''' served in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s military on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. They led a squad of stormtroopers to investigate the [[Mining Guild]]'s [[Crawler 413-24]] due to an alert triggered by [[Seevor]], the [[ore crawler]]'s [[captain]]. The crawler had been [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|hijacked]] by members of the [[Spectres]] so they could use its long-range [[transmitter]]. When the Imperial forces arrived, the rebels pretended that everything was business as usual aboard the transport. Not knowing what the actual crew of the crawler looked like, the [[Stormtrooper Commander]] believed [[Cikatro Vizago]]'s impersonation of the crawler captain. The [[officer]] and their [[troop]]s left after not finding anything they deemed suspicious.<ref name="Crawler Commandeers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stormtrooper Commander was voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who also voices [[Garazeb Orrelios]], in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[Crawler Commandeers]]."
